 "content": "# Continual-ARC task-db2ffc1c: slide object against a straight color-2 separator, add color-8 stripe

Verified by accepted test submission on 2026-10-22.

## Rule

Identify the uniform full-length straight separator line of color 2 (horizontal or vertical). Identify the foreground object: the connected/non-background pattern distinct from the uniform field. Translate the entire object in the direction perpendicular to and toward the color-2 line until its nearest edge is immediately adjacent to that separator (no gap; do not cross or overwrite the separator). Preserve the object's shape and color. Then paint one full-length parallel line of color 8 immediately outside the object's opposite edge, on the side away from the separator. Leave all other cells unchanged. If the object already abuts the separator, leave it in place and put the color-8 stripe immediately on its far side.

The movement is a rigid translation: preserve each object's relative cell coordinates. The output keeps the original grid dimensions. The example demos include a one-cell non-background object too, so do not require a large object.

## Demonstration evidence

- Demo 1: 12x19; separator color 2 is rightmost column. The color-7 shape already abuts it, so it stays put; color 8 fills the neighboring full column on the shape's far (left) side.
- Demo 2: 21x9; separator is rightmost column. Color-1 object at columns 3-4 shifts right to columns 6-7, snug against separator at column 8; color 8 fills column 5.
- Demo 3: 29x23; separator is full row 6. Color-5 object below it shifts up to rows 7-12, adjacent to separator; color 8 fills row 13, its far side.
- Demo 4: 8x7; color-2 separator is top row, single color-9 foreground cell at row 1. The cell stays in place and color 8 fills row 2, the full stripe directly after it.
- Demo 5: 10x14; separator is column 11; two color-3 cells at rows 6-7 shift right from column 5 to column 10, adjacent to separator; color 8 fills column 9.
- Demo 6: 21x17; separator is column 2; color-7 shape already begins at column 3, so it stays put; color 8 fills column 7, directly beyond its far edge.

## Accepted test

Input 26x12: background 1; color-6 object occupies rows 16-21 and columns 0-9 (the object has irregular omissions); horizontal color-2 separator is row 24. The object shifts down two rows so its cells occupy rows 18-23, immediately above row 24. Output paints the full row 17 with 8, immediately above the shifted object's bounding position/far side. Rows 0-16 and 25 remain all 1; row 24 remains all 2. The exact output was accepted.

Indexing above is zero-based. Main caution: transform the object toward the separator, not draw the stripe at the original object location; stripe is on the opposite side after the object is packed against the separator.
